# The `Registry` Class Template Reference

<p>A global registry used in conjunction with static constructors to make pluggable components (like targets or garbage collectors) "just work" when linked with an executable. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/registry/add">Add</a> a node to the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/registry">Registry</a>: this is the interface between the plugin and the executable.</p>


<p>This function is exported by the executable and called by the plugin to add a node to the executable's registry. Therefore it's not defined here to avoid it being instantiated in the plugin and is instead defined in the executable (see LLVM_INSTANTIATE_REGISTRY below).</p>


<p>Definition at line 85 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/registry-h">Registry.h</a>.</p>
